source:
You play as June, a college student aspiring to be a gentleman. 
On your first day of 3rd year in college, you meet Tai.
Who is she? What secret does she have?
Maybe she will teach you how to be a gentleman?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4775970]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你扮演June，一位立志成为绅士的大学生。
在大学三年级的第一天，你遇到了泰。
她是谁？她到底有什么秘密？
也许她会教你如何做一个绅士？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4775970]Steam[/url]]
